Sakurako"How glad I am that you are safe—"
黒瀬"A moment, Didi-ji. Celebrating our reunion must wait."
黒瀬"Now that we have found Masamune, our course must be settled at once. Rokuhara is not the only force nearby. The Occupation troops are here also."
Sakurako"...Yes. Masamune, do you know the present political situation?"
Ichijou"...No. Probably nothing. I was chasing Silver Star all this time..."
Sakurako"Then I will be brief. As planned, we completed our preparations to rescue His Highness Prince Maidono from Kamakura—"
Sakurako"But just before we could act, we learned that Kenchoji was on fire."
Ichijou"————"
黒瀬"Whether His Highness lives, we do not know. Stranger still, Chachamaru Ashikaga, the Horigoe Kubo who attacked Kenchoji, seems to have vanished from that day also..."
Sakurako"Nothing could be done in those circumstances. We remained in hiding, gathering information... Then, in the meantime, Silver Star incidents began occurring one after another on the Boso Peninsula, in numbers never seen before."
黒瀬"The Occupation forces moved, taking advantage of the disturbance. Rokuhara would not stand by, and the two have clashed throughout the region. All Kanto now lies in this confusion."
Sakurako"We tried to do what little we could. Still believing His Highness safe, we searched for him, and for your whereabouts as well... I am glad we found you here."
黒瀬"Indeed. A search with scarcely a clue to follow. But leave that; what comes next is the matter now."
黒瀬"Masamune, we already acknowledge you as our leader. Your will, then, we must hear. For us—the thousand comrades assembled at Katori—where is the way forward?"
Sakurako"...Nothing is clear to us. Should we continue looking for His Highness and wait for our chance...?"
Ichijou"..."

I see.
...So that was how things stood.

Peace was gone.
War had begun.

Many people were dead already. Many more would keep dying.
If someone had brought this about deliberately, it was an evil beyond measure.

And in fact, my will had brought it about.

Ichijou"Nothing changes. Even with the Prince gone, what I... what we do is the same."
黒瀬"...Masamune."
Sakurako"Then..."
Ichijou"We fight."
Ichijou"The Occupation invades, we fight the Occupation. Rokuhara burns towns, we fight Rokuhara."
Ichijou"Everything that harms Yamato is our enemy."
黒瀬"Oh..."
Ichijou"No tyrants. No invaders. Only people who hurt nobody, take from nobody—let them be the ones who remain. To make this country like that is what we're aiming for."
Ichijou"Our... justice."
黒瀬"Those were the words I wished to hear! We of Okabe, with house and name lost—if our lives may be spent on such a cause, then surviving has been worth something!"

en.html:
Kuronose Douji roared.
Beside him, Princess Sakurako nodded.

They trusted me.
...Would follow me down this road.

They would fight because they believed in me.
Kill and be killed, for my justice.

That could never be right.
However unspeakably evil the enemy was, the one who answered by fighting and killing was only another evil. I knew that.

Knew it could never be justice.
And knowing it, I would hold that word up and lead them to the battlefield.

How could that be right?
A terrible mistake. An unforgivable error.

en.html:
If we could keep holding up 'justice' and striking down 'evil'—
Someday... might it not be born?

Justice exists in this world.
There is justice that will not permit evil.

When everybody believed that—

Would they not abandon evil of their own will?
Without someone like Ichijou Ayane having to hurt them, might they not part from wickedness themselves?

If that could happen...

Then a law of the heart would be complete. One that guided people rightly without a fight.

True justice.

I would go there.
That was where I was aiming.

〝正義〟を掲げて〝悪〟を討ち続ける事ができたなら。
　いつか――それは生まれ出ずるのではないか。

　この世には正義があるのだと、
　悪を許さぬ正義があるのだと、
　
　――誰もがそう信じた時。

　人々は自らの意思で、悪を捨て去るのではないか。
　綾弥一条のような者に害されるまでもなく、邪悪と
離別できるのではないか。

　そうなるなら……
　
　それは、
　争わずして人を正しく導く心の法の完成だ。

　<ruby>真実の正義だ<rt>・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。

　あたしはそこへゆく。
　その場所を、目指す。

en.html:
All the memories were there.
All the feelings, overflowing without end.

It hadn't been hard to bear.
Pain, yes. Bitterness, no.

Now I understood. He too had been uncertain. As much as Ichijou Ayane—surely more.

And still, he had answered with everything he had. When I reproached him. Relied on him. Asked him questions.

How could I resent him?

Looking back, the days we'd walked together weren't even so many. How could I sink them into oblivion?

Only gratitude came to me now.

But this wasn't something I could take further.

This hairpin.
These memories, these feelings—I had to leave them here.

To part from him.

As he had answered me with all his strength,
I would answer with all of mine.

Goodbye.
To the feeling that made me hesitate before stepping forward.

ja.html:
記憶のすべてがそこにある。
　止め処なく溢れる想いがそこにある。

　それは決して、辛くはなかった。
　痛みはあっても、苦くはなかった。

　今ならわかる。
　あの人も迷っていたのだと。綾弥一条と同じように。
きっとそれ以上に。

　なのに、あの人はいつも全力で応えてくれた。
　あたしが<ruby>詰<rt>なじ</rt></ruby>っても。頼っても。問い掛けても。

　どうして、あの人を恨めるだろう。

　振り返ってみれば長くもない、あの人と共に歩んだ
日々を、どうして忘却の淵に沈めてしまえるだろう。

　今は感謝の念しか湧かないというのに。
　
　けれど、これはこの先へ持って行くことができない
ものだった。

　この髪挿――
　この記憶、この想いは、ここへ置いてゆかねばなら
ないものだ。

　訣別のために。

　あの人が全力であたしに応えてくれたように、
　あたしも全力であの人に応えるために。

　別れよう。
　前へ踏みしめる一歩をためらわせる、この想いと。
